title: Extending ROC Analysis to Uncertainty-Aware Risk Prediction with an Interval-Based AUC (iAUC)
abstract: arXiv:2602.04775v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In high-stakes risk prediction, interval-valued predictions provide a natural way to represent predictive uncertainty. However, standard evaluation tools such as the receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve and the area under the curve (AUC) are designed for point-valued predictions and do not capture how uncertainty affects discrimination performance. To address this gap, we develop an uncertainty-aware ROC framework and corresponding interval-based AUC (iAUC) metrics for evaluating the performance of interval-valued risk predictions. The framework constructs two ROC-style curves with associated areas $\mathrm{AUC}_L$ and $\mathrm{AUC}_U$, and shows that these quantities induce a three-region decomposition of positive-negative rankings into confidently correct, ambiguous, and confidently incorrect orderings. translated_title: 将ROC分析扩展至不确定性感知的风险预测：基于区间的AUC（iAUC）
translated_abstract: 在高风险预测中，区间值预测为表示预测不确定性提供了一种自然的方式。然而，标准的评估工具（如受试者工作特征曲线（ROC）和曲线下面积（AUC））是为点值预测设计的，无法反映不确定性如何影响判别性能。为弥补这一空白，我们开发了一个不确定性感知的ROC框架以及相应的基于区间的AUC（iAUC）指标，用于评估区间值风险预测的性能。该框架构建了两条ROC风格的曲线及其对应面积 $\mathrm{AUC}_L$ 和 $\mathrm{AUC}_U$，并证明这些量可将正负样本的排序诱导为三个区域的分解：自信正确、模糊以及自信错误的排序。在满足有效类条件覆盖率的前提下，$\mathrm{AUC}_L$ 和 $\mathrm{AUC}_U$ 与成对错误覆盖率……
tldr: 提出不确定性感知的ROC框架与基于区间的AUC（iAUC）指标，用于评估区间值风险预测的判别性能，并将正负样本排序分解为自信正确、模糊和自信错误三个区域。
en_tdlr: This paper extends ROC analysis to uncertainty-aware risk prediction by proposing interval-based AUC (iAUC) metrics that evaluate interval-valued predictions and induce a three-region decomposition of positive-negative rankings into confidently correct, ambiguous, and confidently incorrect orderings.
